title: Support & Memberships
intro: Support from companies and individual donors adds to CalPlug's research funding. It lets us expand outreach and education and do independent research on plug loads, energy efficiency and storage, and user experience.

members.name: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP)

ways.title: Become a member
ways.text: Companies and organizations join as Gold, Platinum or Diamond members and work with our researchers and students.

ways.title: Give a gift
ways.text: Send a check payable to “The UCI Foundation” to: California Plug Load Research Center (CalPlug), ATTN: Herumi Baylon, University of California, Irvine, Irvine, CA 92697-2800.

ways.title: Donate equipment
ways.text: To donate equipment or materials, contact Dr. Shuoyu (Arnold) Wang.

items: Free admission to the biannual CalPlug workshop with networking reception (starting at two tickets for Friends; tickets are transferable to members' affiliates)
Introductions to CalPlug and UCI faculty, staff, and students at event receptions
Facilitating introductions for partnerships with other organizations
Information exchange discussions on key topics with members and topic experts among UCI faculty and staff, using the Center as a neutral ground for discussions among many parties
Formal introductions during CalPlug Workshops and other events, with recognition of membership status
Prioritized for demonstrations of latest products or services at CalPlug events
Opportunity to include news items on CalPlug quarterly reports
Quarterly member-only reports, with inside information on ongoing projects and CalPlug's summary of events in the field
Access to informal consultation with CalPlug technical and research staff
Access to beta tools developed by CalPlug
Opportunity to collaborate on research, development, and demonstration projects
Short training courses on EE and management of plug loads to support company's climate change goals (level of training to be determined)
Access to CalPlug facility tours for members and their affiliates
Preferred access to obtain non-exclusive license to CalPlug inventions
First right access to obtain non-exclusive license and option to obtain exclusive license to CalPlug inventions
Biannual member meetings soliciting opinions on technical and policy issues
Prioritized placement of EE or flexible loads management products in demonstration spaces, including SIM Home and SIM Lab
Access to CalPlug students to discuss internships or jobs (e.g., members speak at professional development talks)
Opportunity to help guide, mentor, and support student design projects (including recognition on posters and publications)
Opportunity to host events such as energy efficiency workshops, seminars, and training sessions for interested groups at the CalPlug facility (specific terms to be agreed)
A plaque on CalPlug's “Wall of Honor”
Acknowledgement on CalPlug's website and publicity materials
Permission to use CalPlug logo on member website to indicate membership
